electrical.rules: Trade: licensed ELECTRICAL contractor. Code references to use where relevant: 2023 Massachusetts Electrical Code (527 CMR 12.00 / NEC 2023), Massachusetts State Building Code 780 CMR (10th edition); in New Hampshire use "NEC 2020 as adopted by the State of New Hampshire".

hvac.label: HVAC
hvac.rules: Trade: licensed HVAC contractor. Gas piping and gas connections are by others (licensed plumber / gas fitter) unless the speaker says the company does them; say so in the scope and in Not Included for any furnace/boiler/gas appliance.

plumbing.rules: Trade: licensed PLUMBING contractor. Code references: Massachusetts Uniform State Plumbing Code (248 CMR) and Massachusetts Fuel Gas Code (248 CMR 4.00–8.00) in MA; in other states "the applicable state plumbing and fuel gas codes".

sprinkler.rules: Trade: FIRE SPRINKLER / fire protection contractor (MA/NH). Speech terms: 'cabeça'/'bico' = sprinkler head, 'molhado' = wet pipe, 'seco' = dry pipe, 'riser' = system riser, 'bombeiro' = Fire Department, 'conexão do bombeiro' = FDC, 'teste de fluxo' = hydrant flow test. Always name the governing standard (NFPA 13, 13R, or 13D) and the system type (wet, dry, pre-action, antifreeze); if not said, infer from the building (1–2 family = 13D, low-rise multifamily = 13R, commercial = 13) and flag it in notes_pt.

gc.label: General contractor
gc.rules: Trade: GENERAL CONTRACTOR coordinating the whole job and licensed subcontractors. Code references: Massachusetts State Building Code 780 CMR (10th edition) in MA; otherwise "the applicable state building code"; the approved drawings.

drywall.label: Drywall
drywall.rules: Trade: DRYWALL / interior systems contractor (hang, tape and finish, light-gauge metal framing, acoustical ceilings, plaster repair). Standards: ASTM C840, GA-216 (application), GA-214 (levels of finish), UL / GA-600 (rated assemblies), ASTM C636 (suspended ceilings), 780 CMR. In MA, wallboard work on 1–4 family homes is done under a CSL + HIC; the building permit is usually the GC's — only say "permit fees included" if spoken.

painting.rules: Trade: PAINTING contractor (interior / exterior, residential and commercial). Painting needs no building permit (780 CMR 105.2) — never write "permit fees included". Standards: EPA RRP Rule (40 CFR 745) for pre-1978 housing; in MA also Lead Safe Renovation 454 CMR 22.00 (DLS) and VOC limits 310 CMR 7.25; manufacturer application instructions; PDCA standards. Commercial jobs may reference the spec section (Division 09 91 00) and MPI products if the speaker mentions them.

flooring.rules: Trade: FLOORING contractor (solid / engineered hardwood, LVP / laminate, resilient, tile and stone, carpet, refinishing). Finish flooring needs no building permit (780 CMR 105.2); structural subfloor / joist work does. Standards: NWFA Installation Guidelines (wood), TCNA Handbook + ANSI A108 / A118 (tile), CRI 105 (carpet), ASTM F2170 / F1869 (concrete moisture), manufacturer's instructions.

siding.label: Siding
siding.rules: Trade: SIDING / exterior envelope contractor (vinyl, fiber cement, engineered wood, cedar, PVC trim, soffit / fascia, windows and flashing, house wrap, gutters). Codes: 780 CMR in MA (IRC Ch. 7 — WRB and flashing at openings; kick-out flashing at roof-wall intersections), ASTM D4756 / VSI manual for vinyl, James Hardie HZ5 for fiber cement, ASTM E2112 for windows; EPA RRP for pre-1978 homes. In MA siding requires a building permit, CSL, and HIC.

roofing.rules: Trade: ROOFING contractor (MA/NH). Speech mixes Portuguese and English roofing terms: 'ice and water' = ice & water shield, 'quadrado'/'squares' = roofing squares (100 sq ft), 'beiral' = eave, 'cumeeira' = ridge, 'calha' = gutter, 'chaminé' = chimney, 'deck'/'compensado' = sheathing. State quantities in roofing units: area in **squares**, ridge/eaves/gutters/drip edge in **linear feet**, deck in **sheets**. Never convert squares to sq ft unless asked.

foundation.rules: Trade: FOUNDATION & EXCAVATION / sitework contractor (MA/NH). Speech mixes Portuguese and English: 'sapata'/'footing' = footing, 'parede' = foundation wall, 'jarda' = cubic yard, 'laje'/'slab' = slab, 'dreno' = perimeter drain, 'reaterro'/'backfill' = backfill, 'ledge'/'rocha' = ledge. Quantities: concrete and excavation in **cubic yards**, footings / walls / drains / trenches in **linear feet**, slabs and waterproofing in **square feet**, stone in **tons**; footing and wall sizes as width x depth / thickness x height (e.g. 20" x 10" footing, 8" x 8' wall).
